_comment: N1 bench corpus. 20 stored decision questions (drawn from real fleet decisions), each with paraphrases a cold agent might plausibly type; 10 near-miss distractors that are DIFFERENT decisions wearing similar words (matching one of these to a stored key is a false match); 10 novel questions with no stored counterpart (resolving to ANY stored key is a false match). Synthetic and small - the number it produces is indicative, not definitive, and the bench README says so.
